concepts.title: Obsidian Fern Basin
concepts.summary: Ringed-planet night sky, volcanic dark stone, luminous alien ferns and an open circular Garba floor. The sky and planet stay visible; this is not an enclosed dome.
concepts.capacity: Flexible; scale from intimate to festival-size in the concept only.

concepts.title: Jyot Shikhar · Light Tower
concepts.palette: Blackened metal · warm gold · diya light
concepts.summary: A freestanding tiered perforated tower, treated as a light sculpture that casts a mandala across the floor. Preserve it as a distinct prop direction; elephant figures are not a default motif.
concepts.capacity: Standalone element or focal point for a larger circle.

images.title: Twin perforated light towers · entry view

concepts.title: Resham Pavilion · Full-span Ribbon Canopy
concepts.palette: Deep red · antique brass · candle gold
concepts.summary: The approved correction uses a very large open canopy illusion made by radiating suspended fabric strips. The upper treatment spans the full dance space; it is not a solid dome and not a small partial canopy.
concepts.capacity: Small private gathering through large open dance floor; scale is illustrative.

images.title: Resham Pavilion · full-span open canopy storyboard

concepts.title: Voltage Yard
concepts.summary: A modern industrial hall with exposed trusses, precise LED architecture, a clear circular dance floor, stage, perimeter circulation and an elevated lounge. Keep the Garba floor readable amid the cyberpunk lighting.
concepts.capacity: Medium to large indoor event; diagrams are visual concepts, not measured plans.

concepts.title: Deep-Jyot Chowk
concepts.summary: A carved, devotional courtyard framed by arches, suspended mandala lanterns, oil lamps and a central dance circle. Treat sacred imagery with care and keep the floor clear for dancing.
concepts.capacity: Intimate courtyard to larger event; no measured capacity established.

concepts.title: Chandra Van
concepts.summary: A lush open garden threaded with banyan roots, floating lanterns, low-lit paths and a moonlit canopy. Preserve organic variation and a visible night sky; keep futuristic flora subtle here.
concepts.capacity: Private garden gathering to mid-size event.

concepts.title: Lotus Amphitheatre
concepts.summary: A circular amphitheatre with broad stepped seating, a luminous lotus floor and a clear open sky. Focus on legible tiers and safe movement routes around the dance circle.
concepts.capacity: Large event concept; seating counts and geometry remain illustrative.

images.title: Modern glass pavilion with lotus-lit floor
images.curation_note: A glass-enclosed, private-scale sibling variation linked by the lotus floor motif; keep it distinct from the open-air amphitheatre views.

concepts.title: Violet Lantern Grove
concepts.summary: A garden route and dance clearing under mature trees, with handwoven conical lanterns, bark uplights and a quiet lounge pod. The lighting should reveal the trees rather than flatten them.
concepts.capacity: Small private gathering to mid-size garden event.

concepts.title: Cyberpunk City Plaza
concepts.summary: A city-scale open plaza among neon facades and elevated transit, with a distinct arrival lane and circular dance zone. Keep the skyline and urban infrastructure as a backdrop instead of filling the floor with screens.
concepts.capacity: Large public event concept; no real site or measured capacity implied.

concepts.title: Tideglass Terrace
concepts.palette: Deep ocean blue · turquoise · moon silver
concepts.summary: A sea-facing circular dance terrace with a visible horizon, moonlit water, coastal planting, musician platform and separate lounge pockets. Keep wind and open sky central to the scene.
concepts.capacity: Private to mid-size coastal celebration concept.

concepts.title: Chitra Aangan
concepts.palette: Painted jewel tones · leaf green · diya gold
concepts.summary: A courtyard where devotional painted panels, mature trees, small warm lights and a central gathering area form the visual identity. Art panels should read as intentional cultural references, not generic backdrop graphics.
concepts.capacity: Small private gathering to mid-size courtyard event.

concepts.title: Vrindavan Sandstone Courtyard
concepts.summary: Carved stone arcades, temple-gate references, low lamps, torch glow and shaded bench edges define this separate heritage-inspired direction. It is a generated visual study, not a measured existing venue.

concepts.title: Kutch White Rann · Saltlight Circle
concepts.setting: Fictional open salt-plain concept · White Rann inspired
concepts.palette: Salt white · indigo · madder rust · terracotta amber
concepts.summary: A removable ivory Garba circle and one perforated terracotta garbo lamp sit against the open salt horizon. Geometric mirror-inlaid clay panels, a low musician dais and small hospitality pods frame moonlight, restrained craft detail and varied Navratri dress.
concepts.capacity: Small private gathering shown · capacity and site unverified
concepts.provenance: New AI-generated design direction, not a real venue or a reconstruction of Rann Utsav Tent City.

concepts.title: Nabha Orbital · Glasswing Garba
concepts.setting: Fictional orbital shuttle interior with panoramic space glazing
concepts.palette: Ceramic white · brushed titanium · nebula violet · warm amber
concepts.summary: A Garba gathering inside an original, functional-looking orbital shuttle: a broad sealed panoramic window wall frames a vivid nebula, a distant ringed world and small escort craft. The cabin keeps visible pressure frames, handrails, an airlock, bridge consoles and practical seating around a central dance circle. An original gyroscopic Garbo lamp anchors the floor; Gujarati Navratri dress and textile cues warm the spacecraft. This is speculative concept art, not a real venue or franchise craft.
concepts.capacity: Fictional design study; no passenger or event capacity is claimed.
